<entry id="I00413">
<head-word>טִיפּוּחַ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (טָפַח I) 
<italic>clapping</italic> of hands (in mourning or rejoicing).</definition>
<notes> Y. Bets. V. 63
<sup>a</sup> ט' שהוא לרצונו 
<italic>tippua</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic> means a clapping which is done purposely, opp. סיפוק spontaneous clapping; M. Kat. 27
<sup>b</sup> ט' ביד 
<italic>tippua</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic> is done with the hands, opp. קילוס, striking of feet.—</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00414">
<head-word>טִיפּוּל</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (טָפַל) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>nursing, attendance, care</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Nidd. II, 4 חייבת … בט' וכ' a woman is bound to nurse her child twenty four months (during which she must not remarry), whether her own &c. B. Mets. 69
<sup>a</sup> טִיפּוּלָהּ מרובה the care-taking of small cattle is more troublesome; Bekh. 26
<sup>b</sup> טִפּ'; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>toilet-paste</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="I00660">טָפל</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 42
<sup>b</sup> טִיפּוּלָן של וכ' the paste used by the daughters of rich men.—
<plural-form>Pl. טִיפּוּלִין,</plural-form> constr. טִיפּוּלֵי. Y. ib. II, beg. 29
<sup>d</sup> אית תניי תני ט' some read in the Mishnah 
<italic>tippulé</italic> (in place of תכשיטי).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>banishment</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="I00433">
<head-word>טִירוֹן, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (tiro, τίρων) 
<italic>young soldier</italic>, trnsf. 
<italic>beginner, novice</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 3, beg. ט' היה וכ' Moses was a novice in prophecy. Y. Erub. V, beg. 22
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to I Kings XVII, 1, where Elijah is for the first time mentioned as a prophet and yet says, ‘the Lord before whom I stood’) והלא אלי' ט' לנבואה היה (not טירונין לנביאים) was not Elijah at that time a novice &c.?—
<plural-form>Pl. טִירוֹנִין</plural-form>. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1 לעסק ט' Ar. (ed. טרופין, corr. acc.) for the levy of soldiers; Pesik. R. s. 10 עליהם טירבוס (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>levy of soldiers</italic>.</definition>

<italic>tributes</italic>.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00438">
<head-word>טִירוּנְיָא, </head-word>
<head-word>טִירוּנְיָיא, </head-word>
<head-word>טִר'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (τυραννία) 
<italic>sovereignty, absolute rule, usurpation</italic> (corresp. to h. זְרוֹעַ).</definition>
<notes> Y. Yeb. VIII, 9
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Kidd. IV, 65
<sup>d</sup> bot. עיקר ט' וכ' the principal designation of their (the priests’) usurpation lies in the words (Hos. IV, 4). Pesik. R. s. 15; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 52
<sup>b</sup>; Lev. R. s. 23, beg. (ref. to בזרוע, Ps. LXXVII, 16) בטר' with imperial power. Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 56
<sup>d</sup> אלו שהן באין בט' לפני וכ' those who come before the Lord with power (interch. with בזרוע). Ab. Zar. 3
<sup>a</sup> אין הקב"ה בא בט'וכ' the Lord does not deal despotically with his creatures. Yalk. Deut. 945 היה עולה אצל אביו בט' (Ruth R. introd. במרוצה) came to his father with arrogance.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00439">
<head-word>טֵירוּף, </head-word>
<head-word>טֵרוּף</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (טָרַף) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (sub. הדעת) 
<italic>confusion, distraction; trouble</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. V, 4 (34
<sup>a</sup>) מפני הטי' because he might become confused (and be unable to resume his prayers); Deut. R. s. 7, beg.—Cant. R. to VIII, 13 בט' הדעת in confusion (not in concert).—Tanḥ. Mick. 2 נטרף טרוף אחד had only one trouble (about the interpretation of his dream).—
<plural-form>Pl. טֵירוּפִין, טֵר'</plural-form>. Ib. נטרף שני ט' had two troubles (not knowing even the dream).—Sifré Deut. 296 (ref. to בדרך, Deut. XXV, 17) בשעת טֵיוּפֵיכֶם when you were in a state of disorder.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ejection, banishment</italic> (cmp. טֵירוּדִין).</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 15; Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXIX (omitt. in ed. Bub.); Yalk. ib. 887 טֵירוּפִי מתוכה my banishment from Eden.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (cmp. תָּעָה) 
<italic>to err, be mistaken</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. II, 3 קרא וט' יחזור למקום שט' if in reading the Sh’ma one made a mistake, he must go back to the passage in which he made a mistake. B. Mets. 63
<sup>b</sup> בכדי שהדעת טוֹעָה within the limits of a reasonable mistake in counting. Snh. 33
<sup>b</sup> ט' בדבר שהצדוקין וכ' if the judge made a mistake in a case in which there is no difference of opinion between the Sadducees and Pharisees. Ib. 6
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. ט' בדבר משנה if the judge gave a wrong decision against an explicit law in the Mishnah; ט' בשיקול הדעת, v. דַּעַת; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to seek, to miss</italic> (cmp. טָעַן I).</definition>
<notes> Taan. III, 8 אבן הטוֹעִים; B. Mets. 28
<sup>b</sup> אבן טוֹעִין Ms. M. (ed. טוֹעַן, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), v. אֶבֶן.—Lev. R. s. 13, beg. אני טָעִיתִי את ההלכה I had 
<italic>forgotten</italic> the law in the case.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִטְעָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to lead astray, to deceive, disappoint</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. VI, 1 הִטְעוּ זה את זה they deceived one another, i.e. the agent employed to engage laborers did not act according to instruction, v. next w.—M. Kat. II, 1 הִטְעוּהוּ פועלים hired men disappointed him. Gen. R. s. 19 end (interpret. 
<italic>hishshiani</italic>, Gen. III, 13) הִטְעַנִי he deceived me with false promises; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּטְעָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be led astray, be deceived</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Balak 5 כמו שהטעה ה' as he led astray, so was he led astray.—Part. מוּטְעֶה, f. מוּטַעַת, מוּטְעֵית 
<italic>misled, brought about by mistake, under false premises</italic>. Yeb. 106
<sup>a</sup> חליצה מ' a 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ălitsah</italic> to which the 
<italic>yabam</italic> consented in consequence of a deception (a promise not kept); Tosef. ib. XII, 13; Keth. 74
<sup>a</sup>.—R. Hash. 25
<sup>a</sup> אתם אפי' מוּטָעִין ‘ye’ (shall appoint), even if deceived by witnesses (your decision stands). Sabb. 101
<sup>b</sup> מוטעין (mattings fastened, or spread) by mistake; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to go astray, worship idols, to be licentious</italic> &c. Targ. Am. VII, 17.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ex. XXXIV, 15 ויִטְעוֹן (ed. Amst. O. ויִטְעוּן). Ib. 16 ויַטְעַיָן ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. ויִטְעַיַין, Y. I וכד טַעֲיָין, Y. II וִיטַעֲיָן); a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 87, beg. (expl. סררת Prov. VII, 11) טַעֲיָא running about, prostitute, v. טָעִיתָא.</notes></sense>

<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to forget</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. II, 17. Ib. XXXI, 5; 7. Ib. VI, 20 (ed. Vien. תטעי מנימוסא 
<italic>deviate from</italic>).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַטְעֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lead astray, to deceive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Deut. XXVII, 18 יַטְעֵי (not יִטְ'). Targ. Ex. XXXIV, 16; a. fr.—B. Mets. 76
<sup>a</sup> אַטְעוּ פועלים וכ' the hired men deceived (the one engaging the others deceived them as to their wages, v. preced.); (Var. אִיטְּעוּ וכ' they were deceived by one of their own).—Ḥull. 94
<sup>b</sup> מַטְעוּ נפשייהו they deceive themselves; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prostitute</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 29.</notes></sense>

<notes>. Targ. II Chr. XXIV, 17 (v. Ex. R. s. 8).—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to be forgotten, to ignore</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. XVII, 14 אַטְעֵי (ed. Lag. מטעי, prob. to be read: אַטֵּישׁ, h. text נְטוֹשׁ.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>

<italic>to be deceived</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
